title: FoveAI Canonical Theme Specification
description: The Master Token Contract for the FoveAI Theme Ecosystem (Web, GTK, Unity)

theme_id.description: Unique identifier for this generated theme

background_prompt.description: The original generative AI prompt used for the background

background_image_url.description: The URL or base64 path to the generated background image

fv_bg_dark.description: Deep background color (HEX) for solid surfaces or Unity fill lights

fv_accent.description: Primary accent color (HEX) for buttons, Unity key lights

ui_structure.description: Structural math defining how the UI components warp

css_grid_template_columns.description: Radical CSS Grid columns, e.g. '300px 1fr 1fr' or 'minmax(200px, auto) 1fr'

css_grid_areas.description: Grid template areas defining the layout structure

ui_clicks.description: URL to the generated UI click sound effect

ambient_loop.description: URL to the generated ambient background loop
